cause: Context Pack was frozen before development started.
impact: The line has an evidence-bound starting context.
lesson: Freeze the initial context before changing implementation state.

cause: The first formal append help invocation imported the linked workbench-v1.8.6 source instead of this worktree and failed before dispatch because the target development-control API was unavailable; the command was corrected with the target backend on PYTHONPATH.
impact: The first event append command did not run and formal evidence required an environment correction.
lesson: Run formal control commands with the target worktree backend explicitly first when linked worktrees share a virtual environment.

cause: The real persisted-child transform-to-model regression completed the renamed transform step but model genesis was rejected at result artifact admission with WORKFLOW_TARGET_RUN_MISMATCH because the foreign child model branch was compared to the original target artifact instead of the typed upstream source.
impact: A valid transform-to-model workflow cannot complete even though the transform child is persisted and bound.
lesson: Typed model source admission must validate the upstream produced binding against server-owned producer provenance, not assume every model source is the workflow target artifact.

cause: After the first admission guard was corrected, canonical model completion still rejected the valid child source because its source_refs validator independently required the original target artifact.
impact: The valid child source passed artifact admission but could not be durably completed under the canonical model branch contract.
lesson: Search every completion and resume validator for the same target-artifact assumption after changing a typed source admission rule.

cause: The typed child source fix was verified through the P4 regression, workflow admission/runtime regression, compile check, and diff check.

evidence.ref: tests/test_agent_data_management_p4.py; tests/test_v189_workflow_truth.py; tests/test_workflow_runtime.py; compileall; git diff --check

impact: The valid persisted transform-to-model path is green while receipt-bound foreign artifact and source identity checks remain active.
lesson: A green integration path is only admissible when child source identity is proven by the current server producer provenance and target-run boundary.

cause: The line acceptance boundary is satisfied by the verified typed transform-to-model path and its focused security regressions.
impact: The formal line can be closed with its failure history, gate evidence, and scope boundaries recorded.
lesson: Close the formal line only after the real persisted-child path, admission regressions, compile check, diff check, and event-chain verification are all fresh.

cause: The first explicit git add was blocked by the shared worktree index lock permission; the same exact allowlisted paths were staged successfully after explicit elevated authorization.

evidence.ref: git add target implementation, test, and formal evidence paths

impact: Commit staging was delayed until the shared Git metadata boundary was authorized; no code or unrelated worktree path was changed by the failed attempt.
lesson: In a shared worktree, stage only explicit task paths and request elevated Git metadata access when the index lock is outside the writable source boundary.
